Review details ### Suppressed comments (1) **src/lib/services/member-gateway.svelte.ts:301** * Medium: A `final` event for an older run can enter this branch while `chat.runId` belongs to a newer send, and `loadHistory(current)` then starts a shared history operation that can replace the newer message/stream when it resolves. Treat a mismatched run ID as stale and return without reloading history; the current run will refresh history on its own completion. ``` if (payload.runId && chat.runId && payload.runId !== chat.runId) { if (payload.state === 'final') loadHistory(current); return; ``` - **Files reviewed:** 43/45 changed files - **Comments generated:** 1 - **Review effort level:** Lite

@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+# Site gateway integration fixture
+
+This fixture mounts the actual members page, service, member state and installed shared client. Only the page's server/user identity data and the remote server responses are synthetic. The native browser WebSocket, local HTTP signing request, connection handshake, service session ownership and Svelte UI updates run together.
+
+The private manifest and Bun lock select `deps/minion-stack-shared-0.9.0-qc-d01a528579e7.tgz`, SHA256 `d01a528579e7b0877d05565b9d3ad2747ab45610d634948f51b6a25b4bf4f756`. All 44 installed members must match this archive. Version `0.9.0` alone does not identify these bytes. The archive is a private qualification input; license provenance, registry publication, active adoption and deployment remain separate gates.
comments.body: High: `tests/fixtures/member-gateway-parity/README.md:5` records an exact tarball digest, but the qualification only compares the installed package before/after (`scripts/qc/ui-fixtures.mjs:425-533`) and the contract hashes three installed files (`src/lib/services/member-gateway.contract.fixture.ts:177-196`). A different local archive can therefore pass these checks while changing other package members or dependencies. Verify the tarball (or complete installed-package inventory) against the documented SHA-256 before accepting the fixture.
